title: Baked Potato Dip
description: This baked potato dip is a creamy blend of classic baked potato toppings including sour cream, Cheddar cheese, green onions, and bacon.

steps.text: Whisk cream cheese, sour cream, and ranch dressing mix together in a large bowl until smooth. Stir in green onions, Cheddar cheese, and bacon bits. Cover and refrigerate overnight before serving.
